Add explicit paid-access MCP tool names and operator env configuration for Alipay order creation and entitlement checks.
Initial release: chat-native Chinese system-novel power fantasy simulator with apocalypse hoarding, system archetypes, image rhythm, portable runtime state, and Alipay paid-access integration notes.
